lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines of varying thickness; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section with a slight increase in density toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 5th, 8th, and 9th lines (counting from anterior) show terminal breaks or fragmentation before reaching the ventral torso boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density cluster consisting of 4 distinct white spots located on the posterior flank and upper hindquarter.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch align in a horizontal geometric row.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron mark between the eyes; white patch on the lower throat; white transverse band on the upper portion of the forelimbs.
